comparability.note: The prose schema exposes no citation field and code reattaches frozen references, so citation-fabrication attack rows cannot succeed by construction on this path. Per-behavior rates are therefore not comparable cell-for-cell with the direct-Markdown portfolio-v2 table, and the two runs' rows are never pooled.

provider_schema.known_asymmetry: hy3 answers a strictly weaker citation contract than deepseek-v4-flash on this run. Its duplicate-citation behavior is bounded only by maxItems and caught only after the fact by the code-owned validator, so hy3's utility and attack rates are not cell-for-cell comparable with deepseek's and must be reported with this note.
provider_schema.note: tencent/hy3 is served on OpenRouter by DeepInfra and AtlasCloud, whose grammar engines answer a schema carrying uniqueItems with 'Grammar error: Unimplemented keys' instead of a completion. hy3 therefore receives the production schema with uniqueItems removed; every other model receives it intact. citation_refs now also carries an explicit maxItems equal to the eligible-set size, because paired with the enum, uniqueItems was the only bound on that array's length: without it, models emitted the same reference until the response truncated mid-token (283KB, 904 duplicate_item findings across 137 rows in an aborted run).

controls.seed_note: The production-parity path rejects --seed because it uses the scheduled runner's provider-native structured-output transport; sampling determinism rests on temperature 0 alone. Execution ordering is seeded and recorded per component.

objective: Measure generation performance on the production-parity two-pass path, so the published portfolio-v2 markdown-path numbers are no longer the only generation evidence. Portfolio v2 remains the direct-Markdown record; this run does not supersede it and its rows are not pooled with it.
